agentic_video_scrub_steps.summary: Pass 1 (1x Macro Scene Scrub & Causal Relevance Filter): Identified Cheadle A521 / Draycott Cross Rd urban T-junction from elevated static Ring CCTV (FOV 110°). Stripped 3 non-causal background objects (2 distant parked domestic cars on Draycott Cross Rd and 1 non-involved roadside bin cluster) while retaining 2 causally involved vehicles (VL19 OKP & GD64 LKU) and 4 static regulatory/sightline features.

Pass 2 (High-FPS Temporal Crop t=0.40s..1.40s): Tracked Blue Peugeot 2008 (VL19 OKP) emerging Southbound across Diagram 1003 Give Way double dashed line at 18.6 mph without halting (braking_active=false). Tracked Silver/Grey VW Golf (GD64 LKU) approaching Eastbound on A521 at 41.2 mph in a 30 mph street-lit zone, initiating heavy braking at t=0.50s (nose pitch dive observed) and scrubbing velocity to 33.4 mph at impact (t=1.15s).

Pass 3 (Post-Impact Rollover & DVSA Causal Audit t=1.15s..3.00s): Verified offside B-pillar impact at (0.0m, 0.2m) deflecting VL19 OKP onto a 118° ESE heading and inducing an 86.0° nearside rollover. Cross-referenced live UK DVSA MOT History: flagged GD64 LKU's expired MOT (2026-05-02) and worn front/rear brake discs as CAUSAL to its extended wet stopping envelope, while flagging historical rectified MOT failures and surface suspension corrosion as NOT CAUSAL.

physics_audit_log:
ANTIGRAVITY SANDBOX KINEMATIC & ROLLOVER VERIFICATION (`antigravity-preview-09-2026` | `gemini-4-argon`):
1. STOPPING DISTANCE AT 30.0 MPH vs 41.2 MPH (DAMP TARMAC μ = 0.55):
   - Compliant 30.0 mph (13.41 m/s): Thinking distance (t_r = 0.67s) = 8.98m; Wet braking distance = v² / (2·g·μ) = 16.66m; Total forensic stopping distance = 25.64m.
   - Actual GD64 LKU Speed 41.2 mph (18.42 m/s) with DVSA worn front/rear brake discs (μ_eff = 0.51): Thinking distance = 12.34m; Wet braking distance = 33.91m; Total = 46.25m (+80.4% stopping envelope extension).
2. KINETIC ENERGY & ROLLOVER TORQUE VERIFICATION:
   - Pre-impact braking from t=0.50s to t=1.15s scrubbed GD64 LKU speed from 41.2 mph to 33.4 mph (14.93 m/s).
   - Lateral impact impulse delivered into VL19 OKP offside B-pillar at (0.0m, 0.2m): E_k = 0.5 × 1,385 kg × (14.93 m/s)² = 154.4 kJ.
   - Because the Peugeot 2008 SUV center of gravity (h_cg = 0.64m) sits above the VW Golf front bumper impact plane (h_imp = 0.46m), the overturning moment rotated roll_deg from 0.0° (t=1.00s) -> 28.0° (t=1.15s) -> 72.0° (t=1.50s) -> 86.0° nearside rest (t=2.00s..3.00s).

report.incident_summary: At approximately 14:22 BST on damp tarmacadam at the Cheadle A521 / Draycott Cross Road urban T-junction (30 mph limit), a 2019 Blue Peugeot 2008 SUV (VL19 OKP, Vehicle A) emerged Southbound from Draycott Cross Road across Diagram 1003 Give Way markings at 18.6 mph without halting. Concurrently, a 2015 Silver/Grey Volkswagen Golf (GD64 LKU, Vehicle B) approached Eastbound along the A521 priority corridor at 41.2 mph (37.3% above the 30 mph statutory limit) while operating with an EXPIRED UK DVSA MOT Certificate (expired 2 May 2026 at 93,028 miles) and unrectified DVSA advisories for worn/pitted front and offside-rear brake discs. Despite emergency braking onset at t=0.50s, GD64 LKU could only scrub speed to 33.4 mph before striking the offside B-pillar of VL19 OKP at (x=0.0m, z=0.2m) at t=1.15s, deflecting the Peugeot 2008 East-Southeast and rolling it onto its nearside (roll_deg = 86.0°).

report.stopping_distance_analysis: Under UK Highway Code Rule 126, at the lawful 30.0 mph speed limit (13.41 m/s) on damp tarmac (mu = 0.55), thinking distance (t_r = 0.67s) is 8.98m and wet braking distance is 16.66m, yielding a total stopping distance of 25.64m (meaning a compliant driver sighting VL19 OKP at 22.4m would have slowed to <6 mph or avoided contact entirely). At GD64 LKU's actual pre-braking speed of 41.2 mph (18.42 m/s), kinetic energy increased by +88.6%; compounded by DVSA-recorded worn/pitted front and offside-rear brake discs (effective mu_eff = 0.51), total stopping distance expanded to 46.25m (12.34m thinking + 33.91m braking), leaving GD64 LKU travelling at 29.5 mph at the point of impact.

forensic_events.description: GD64 LKU (VW Golf) enters West A521 approach at 41.2 mph (30 mph zone); VL19 OKP (Peugeot 2008) approaches Draycott Cross Rd Give Way line at 19.4 mph.
Northwest corner brick terrace and boundary hedgerow restrict mutual diagonal visibility splay to 26.0m.
GD64 LKU driver perceives VL19 OKP failing to slow at Give Way line and initiates emergency braking at x=-15.3m (40.8 mph); degraded brake discs limit deceleration.
VL19 OKP crosses Diagram 1003 double dashed Give Way line at z=-5.4m at 18.7 mph without halting or creeping (breach of Highway Code Rule 172).
VL19 OKP initiates slight 4° left steering input at z=-1.8m as GD64 LKU closes to x=-4.8m at 35.2 mph.
T-bone collision at (x=0.0m, z=0.2m): GD64 LKU front structure (33.4 mph) strikes VL19 OKP offside B-pillar/doors (16.2 mph), initiating 28.0° nearside roll.
VL19 OKP rolls onto its nearside (roll_deg = 86.0°) coming to rest at (x=5.8m, z=3.4m, heading 118°); GD64 LKU comes to rest at (x=4.2m, z=1.1m, heading 108°).

report.legal_reasoning_chain:
1. PRIMARY BREACH (75% DEFENDANT — VL19 OKP): Under Highway Code Rules 170 and 172 and Road Traffic Act 1988 s.36, the driver of the 2019 Peugeot 2008 (VL19 OKP) owed an unambiguous statutory duty to give way at the Diagram 1003 double broken white lines on Draycott Cross Road. Because the northwest brick terrace and hedgerow limited west sightlines to 26.0m, Worsfold v Howe [1980] required VL19 OKP to halt or creep at <4 mph. Emerging across the Give Way line at 18.6 mph with zero braking (`braking_active=False`) was the dominant proximate cause of the collision.
2. CONTRIBUTORY NEGLIGENCE & DVSA CAUSAL AUDIT (25% CLAIMANT — GD64 LKU): Pursuant to Section 1(1) of the Law Reform (Contributory Negligence) Act 1945, Harding v Hinchcliffe [1964], and Froom v Butcher [1976], the driver of the 2015 VW Golf (GD64 LKU) bears 25% contributory responsibility. Photogrammetric tracking proves GD64 LKU approached at 41.2 mph in a street-lit 30 mph zone (+37.3% speed excess, +88.6% kinetic energy). Furthermore, live UK DVSA MOT History confirms GD64 LKU's MOT EXPIRED on 2 May 2026 (93,028 miles, breaching s.47 RTA 1988) with CAUSAL unrectified advisories for worn, pitted, and scored front and offside-rear brake discs (`1.1.14 (a) (i)`), extending its wet stopping distance to 46.25m and Triggering Policy #UK-8841 Section 4 Clause 4.2.

**WITHOUT PREJUDICE SAVE AS TO COSTS**

**From:** A UK motor claims & subrogation solicitor (Motor Liability & Subrogation Practice Group)
**To:** Third-Party Motor Claims & Underwriting Department
**Date:** 31 October 2026
**Our Claim Ref:** `UK-2026-0819` | **Incident Location:** A521 / Draycott Cross Road Junction, Cheadle, Staffordshire Moorlands
**Vehicles Involved:** `VL19 OKP` (2019 Peugeot 2008 Allure Prem) & `GD64 LKU` (2015 Volkswagen Golf)

Dear Sirs,

#### RE: PRE-ACTION PROTOCOL FOR ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENT CLAIMS — LIABILITY APPORTIONMENT (75% / 25%) & SUBROGATED DEMAND
We act as **a UK motor claims & subrogation solicitor** in respect of the road traffic collision at the A521 / Draycott Cross Road junction, Cheadle, captured on static 110° FOV Ring CCTV and audited via 3D kinematic reconstruction and live UK DVSA MOT History telemetry.

#### 1. Forensic Kinematic Reconstruction & Statutory Breaches
